security.title: Security centre
security.intro: Banking safely is a partnership. Here is how we protect you and how you can protect yourself.
security.t1: Never share your password or codes
security.d1: Harbourline staff will never ask for your password, PIN or one-time codes, by any channel.
security.d2: Add an authenticator app under Security in your portal for a second layer of protection.
security.d3: Use at least 10 characters with upper and lower case letters, a number and a symbol. Never reuse passwords.
security.d4: Only sign in on our official website, over a secure HTTPS connection.
security.d5: Check your transactions and notifications often, and contact us at once if anything looks unfamiliar.
security.reportText: Contact support immediately so we can protect your accounts.

support.title: Support
support.intro: Answers to common questions, and how to reach us.
support.q1: How do I activate my account?
support.a1: Your bank creates your account and sends you a one-time activation link by email, SMS and WhatsApp. Open the link and choose your own password.
support.a2: Select “Forgot your password?” on the login page. We will send a reset link to your registered email and phone.
support.a3: Activation links are valid for a limited time. Contact us and we will send a new one.
support.q4: How do I change my language?
support.a4: Use the language selector in the top bar at any time. Signed-in clients have their choice saved to their profile.
support.a5: Accounts can be suspended for security or compliance reasons. Contact support to have the status reviewed.
